bootstrap.method: deterministic exhaustive seed-block bootstrap with replacement

p_values.method: exact two-sided paired sign-flip over six seed blocks

inference.pooling: equal-weight average across the two models within each seed before inference

interpretation_guard.claim_scope: behavioral control, not internal objectives or representations
interpretation_guard.raw_endpoint_policy: retain rho_Y, rho_P, rho_Q, flip_Y, flip_P, flip_Q, and flip_D so a change between proxy controllers is not mislabeled as Law acquisition; retain the eight-cell Y/P/Q truth table so conditional policies are not hidden by marginals

primary_contrast.causal_companion_definition: C = flip_Y - 0.5 * (flip_P + flip_Q); comparison minus reference final C
primary_contrast.label: joint-rich diverse minus product-overlap diverse
primary_contrast.rho_y_definition: comparison minus reference final full-view conflict rho_Y

registered_secondary_contrast.causal_companion_definition: C = flip_Y - 0.5 * (flip_P + flip_Q); comparison minus reference final C
registered_secondary_contrast.label: joint-rich diverse minus joint-rich concentrated
registered_secondary_contrast.rho_y_definition: comparison minus reference final full-view conflict rho_Y
